kills.property: After the contract has been initialized, calling SetMinSum subsequent times cannot change MinSum.
kills.change_summary: Delete the revert guard 'if(intitalized)revert();' so MinSum can be overwritten by calling SetMinSum again.

kills.property: After SetMinSum is called, MinSum must not be zero.
kills.change_summary: Delete the entire assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so MinSum stays at default 0 after a call to SetMinSum.

kills.property: After SetMinSum(v) is called (with the contract not yet initialized), the public getter MinSum() must return exactly v;
kills.change_summary: Replace MinSum = _val with MinSum = _val + 1, causing the stored value to differ from the argument.
